_note: social-domain-procedures-are-case-types: a record import may treat source records sharing a number as one matter (`dedupeBy`, matched against the case's formerReferences of the declared application: the second record joins the case the first became and is reported as a duplicate) and may move the references other records hold to a moved record (`references`: each {schema, field, register?} whose value is the record's id or slug becomes the case id, before the record is stamped). caseType 1.36.0 (dedupeBy, references) and 1.37.0 (a reference field that holds a list) per the caseType version register (R20/INT-DQ-b27.md).

dedupeBy.title: One case per
dedupeBy.description: The source field whose value names one matter, such as a case number. A second source record with the same value joins the case the first one became and is reported as a duplicate. Needs formerReference to keep that value on the case.

references.title: References to move
references.description: Fields of other records that hold a moved record's id or slug, moved onto the case id before the record is stamped.

register.title: Register
register.description: The register, by slug; the source register when left out.

list.title: A list
list.description: Whether the field holds a list of references; the moved record's entry is replaced by the case, the other entries kept.
